srList.sentence: Methods Participants Structural MR images were acquired for a sample of 29 male veterans with impulsive aggression problems, recruited from four outpatient clinics of the Military Mental Healthcare Organization in the Netherlands, and 30 non-aggressive combat controls, recruited through advertisements or participation in prior research at our department.

srList.sentence: Statistical analysis The significance of group differences in anger ( STAXI-2 ) and aggression ( BPAQ) , as well as anxiety ( MASQ-AA) , depression ( MASQ-AD) , and PTSD ( PSS ) scores was tested via independent samples t tests .

sentenceParts.c: Statistical analysis The significance of group differences in anger ( STAXI-2 ) and aggression ( BPAQ) , as well as anxiety ( MASQ-AA) , depression ( MASQ-AD) , and PTSD ( PSS ) scores was tested via independent samples t tests .

srList.sentence: A multivariate analysis of variance was used to determine whether the interaction term group × age should be included in the models; if a significant omnibus effect of group × age was detected at the multivariate level , the interaction term was added to each of the individual GLMs .
